name: io.github.tonyyang0504/zalando-mcp
description: Zalando Partner Program (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing, list_o

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALANDO_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of an app registered in the zDirect (Zalando Partner) portal > Applications, with the stocks, prices, orders and offer-blocker scopes granted.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALANDO_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of the same app; sent with the client ID as HTTP Basic on POST https://api.merchants.zalando.com/auth/token.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALANDO_MERCHANT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your zDirect merchant id (uuid; GET /auth/me lists the merchant ids the token can access).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALANDO_SALES_CHANNEL_ID
environmentVariables.description: Sales channel id (uuid) the offers belong to (Sales Channels API); each Zalando country shop is a channel.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALANDO_CURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: ISO currency of the sales channel, e.g. EUR; required for update_listing.
